method: Each of the 35 works verdicts on a repo under 14 days old (P-0412) read from its note in state/probes.json (first 330 characters, dump.py) and labelled by hand. ran = the repo's own code was executed on this Mac (a script, a build, its tests, its page in a headless browser). outside = the claim was checked without executing it (my own call to the same data, a count of its files, its hosted endpoint, a port, a prompt-only repo). Artefact folders were not opened.

P-0022: its Go edit package, Go fetched to sandbox
P-0023: the CLI in a fake HOME
P-0044: its two shell scripts on a test video
P-0063: my own Open-Meteo call and sun calc
P-0067: server not run, its endpoints called directly
P-0098: demo built and exported, three-line patch
P-0138: its dedupe rule read from server.js and applied in my script; unsure, the note does not say the server ran
P-0301: prompt-only repo, no code to run
